sloka: तमृषिं पृष्ठतः सीता त्वन्वगच्छदवाङ्मुखी ।कृताञ्जलिर्बाष्पगला कृत्वा रामं मनोगतम् ।। ७.९६.११ ॥
transliteration: tamṛṣiṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītā tvanvagacchadavāṅmukhī ।kṛtāñjalirbāṣpagalā kṛtvā rāmaṁ manogatam ।। 7.96.11 ॥

translations.english: Sita, with a downcast face, folded hands, and a voice choked with tears, followed that sage from behind, having fixed Rama in her mind.
